desc: Appointment of Sh. Giridhar Aramane, IAS (Retd.) as Chairman & Managing Director of M/s Unitech Limited w.e.f. 25.08.2026.

Dear Sir/Ma''am,
Disclosure is in pursuance of Regulation 30 of the SEBI(Listing Obligations and disclosure Requirements) Regulations,2015 read with sub-clause 16(g) of Clause A of Part A of schedule III, we wish to inform you that 14th meeting of Committee of Creditors of Unitech International Limited is scheduled on 07.08.2026,Friday at 12:00P.M. through video conferencing has been deferred and is scheduled to be held on Monday, 10.08.2026 at 3:00P.M. through video conferencing. The said meeting has been further rescheduled and will be held on Tuesday, 11.08.2026 at 11:30A.M. through video conferencing. 
The outcome of the meeting are:- 
Agenda Item No. B1:- To ratify CIRP expenses incurred by the RP as per regulation 34 of IBBI(CIRP) regulation,2016 - Deferred by Committee of Creditors for next meeting 
Agenda Item No. C1:- To consider and approve filing of an application before Hon''ble NCLT seeking further extension of the CIRP period by 60 days - Approved

Dear Sir/Ma''am,
Disclosure is in the pursuance of Regulation 30 of the SEBI(Listing Obligation & Disclosure Requirements) Regulation, 2015 read with sub-clause 16(g) of Clause A of Part-A Schedule III, we would like to inform you that 15th meeting of Committee of Creditors of Unitech International Limited was scheduled on 20.08.2026 , Thursday at 05:30 P.M. through video conferencing.
